title: Bound stranded-child discovery cost to open candidates and one attribution anchor
outcome: Bound stranded-child discovery cost to open candidates and one attribution anchor
acceptance: Stranded-child discovery starts from open children and short-circuits canonical participation probes after one matching anchor per completed parent
A VM-step or scale regression shows unrelated completed history does not increase stranded-child discovery work; documentation describes the actual query bound

completion.summary: Stranded-child discovery now starts from indexed Open child candidates, groups siblings and stops canonical session-participation probing after the first matching anchor per Completed parent. A production VM-step regression proves unrelated Completed history adds no discovery work; docs state the actual Open-candidate and related-history bound.
